decisive_items: Noncontrast computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging of the brain showed no abnormalities
response.rationale: The visual pathway appears structurally and electrophysiologically intact, with normal pupils, posterior segment examination, VEP, ERG, and brain imaging. This is incompatible with retinal concussion, traumatic optic neuropathy, or a structural TBI and instead favors a non-organic post-traumatic conversion blindness.

rejected.why: Commotio retinae would produce retinal fundus and ERG abnormalities, which are absent.
Traumatic brain injury would not explain persistent bilateral blindness with a normal neurologic examination and normal CT/MRI.
Traumatic optic neuropathy would be associated with abnormal VEP or pupillary involvement, which are not present.
